orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: What is a UID (Unique Identifier) and how does a fallback mechanism work in computer systems?
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• A **UID (Unique Identifier)** is a unique code or number given to a user or system process so it can be easily identified without any confusion, just like a roll number in school.

• A **Fallback** is an automatic backup plan used by a computer program if the main feature fails, helping the system stay running without stopping.

• **Debugging** means finding and fixing small errors or glitches in computer software, similar to finding and correcting mistakes in your homework.

• In computing, **UID fallback debug** refers to a technical diagnostic process where a system uses a backup identification mechanism to trace and resolve minor software errors.
